About

Mechanical Engineering graduate from the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore, with practical exposure to industrial maintenance, manufacturing processes and production operations.

Experience spans preventive and corrective maintenance on production machinery, troubleshooting mechanical and pneumatic faults, and coordinating repairs through ERP-based maintenance systems — alongside hands-on project work in renewable energy, automation and hydraulic systems, from CAD design through fabrication and testing.
